remarks: Discover the perfect setting for your dream home on this beautiful 2.5-acre parcel located on a quiet dead-end road in the Fredonia School District. With 546 feet of road frontage and a mix of wooded and open land, this property offers the ideal balance of privacy and natural beauty.  The land is situated in the Agricultural District and zoned 311 Res VA Land, providing flexibility for a build-to-suit project. A meandering creek adds character and charm to the property, while the surrounding countryside provides peaceful views and a serene atmosphere.  A survey has already been completed, and electric is available at the road, making your building plans even easier to bring to life. Whether you’re looking to construct your forever home or invest in a tranquil getaway, this parcel offers the space, scenery, and setting you’ve been searching for.
